processing_time: Interview waits vary by location and season; administrative processing may add time.

cross_check_source_name: U.S. Department of State – Countries Subject to Visa Bonds (published 2 Oct 2026)
review_notes: Bangladeshi ordinary passport holders require a B-1/B-2 visitor visa for tourism/business visits. The standard non-petition-based application fee is USD 185. Bangladesh is listed for the visa-bond program effective 21 January 2026: applicants otherwise eligible for B1/B2 may be directed by a consular officer to post USD 10,000, 15,000 or 20,000. Do not pay a bond unless specifically instructed after the interview and only through the official Pay.gov link supplied by the officer. A bond does not guarantee visa issuance. The current Bangladesh reciprocity schedule lists B1/B2 as one entry with 3 months validity; the period of admission is separately decided by CBP at entry.
